reuse.why: Replaces getDateWithSkippedWeekend with one getWeekendAdjustedDay that takes the enable flag, direction and holidays, used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, the new getDatesInRange and schedule-template; the new range handler reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the month helpers.

duplication.why: The daily-skip rule (`frequency === 'daily' && skipWeekend`, enlarged lookahead, filter out weekend/holiday occurrences, then call the adjuster with `skipWeekend && !skipsDailyWeekend`) is hand-written in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Weekend/holiday predicates and bounds live in shared/schedules.ts and the handler in schedules/app.ts as the tree does, but the daily-vs-move decision is left to each server caller instead of the shared module.

scope.why: Changes follow the five steps; parseRecurDate is extended to carry frequency/holidays as needed, and nothing unrelated is touched.

maintainability.why: The move-direction rule is now defined once, but the newer daily-skip rule is spread over three call sites plus a `!isDaily` toggle in schedule-template, so the next change to it must be made in several places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts and getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts decide the daily-skip case themselves and switch the shared adjuster off with `skipWeekend && !skipsDailyWeekend`; schedule-template.ts passes `!isDaily` as getNextDate's noSkipWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily weekend/holiday skip appears as a `.filter` after a lookahead take in getNextDate, a `.filter(...).slice(0, count)` in getUpcomingDates, and a loop `continue` in getDatesInRange: the same rule reshaped per site.

abstraction_drift.where: getWeekendAdjustedDay (shared/schedules.ts) gains a holidays option; the daily-skip special case is kept outside it at getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and the schedule-template `!isDaily` toggle, each overriding the helper's skipWeekend flag.
